description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. GPS-located gauging sites identify where Surface Water Management measures streamflow for stormwater permits, watershed planning and emergency management. The native layer exposes point geometry and named attributes, including ID, NAME, BASIN_GP, ACTIVE, INSTALL_DT, HYDRO_TY. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for emergency response studies. This is the site inventory with installation/status fields, not the streamflow observations themselves. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
